regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and Supporting Information line
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate catalyst/base claim were inspected. The SI line only states online availability; source_mapping marks association unestablished, so no SI facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 Introduction
regions.finding: Prior synthetic methods and Marshall chirality-transfer work are literature context. Their generic comparison drawings occur on page 2 and are classified as general schemes, not current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 Results and Discussion, catalyst/ligand and base-screen prose
regions.finding: Narrative observations were linked to Table 1 entries 1–8 and Table 2 entries 1–5 on page 3. No duplicate experiments were created; unavailable SI solvent screening was not reconstructed.

unresolved: The SI-only solvent screen is unavailable and was not inferred.
Most operating details for optimization rows are not printed in the narrative and remain missing unless present in the page-3 table.

regions.region: page 2 upper Scheme 1
regions.finding: Seven cited synthetic strategies [11]–[18] are shown around a generic chiral allenoate. The diagram is a literature-method overview with generic R groups, not current-paper experiment arrows.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Scheme 2
regions.finding: Marshall prior-work ranges and the current method's aggregate range are compared. The figure is classified as a general comparison; it does not uniquely specify individual runs.

regions.region: page 2 center prose on leaving groups and alcohols
regions.finding: The carbonate near-failure, phosphate/tosylate results, and methanol/ethanol/isobutanol outcomes map to six separate Scheme 3 lines on page 3, including the I2 derivatization footnote for ee.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Table 3 scope discussion
regions.finding: Narrative substrate trends and longer-time exceptions were linked to the sixteen Table 3 rows on page 4 rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 1/2 generic structures and aggregate ranges cannot be decomposed into unique experiments.
Scheme 3 omits scale, workup, purification, and isolated masses.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 1 reaction drawing, ligand structures, rows 1–8, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Eight catalyst/ligand optimization experiments were retained row-by-row with shared scale/conditions, isolated yield, HPLC ee, the 6 mol% PPh3 override, and entry-6 56% NMR starting-material recovery.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1–5, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Five base-screen experiments were retained separately with base 1.1 equiv, shared conditions, isolated yields, and HPLC ee values.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Scheme 3 six printed condition/result lines and footnotes
regions.finding: Six independent leaving-group/alcohol experiments were retained. The carbonate row keeps 2% product, missing ee, and 89% recovered starting material; I2 analytical derivatization is represented for the three alcohol-variation ee values.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 4 and adjacent configuration-assignment prose
regions.finding: One iodolactonization experiment was retained: 2b (90% ee), I2 2 equiv, MeCN/H2O 15:1, −15 °C, 11 h gives 3 in 88% isolated yield and 89% ee, >99% ee after recrystallization. Figure 1/X-ray supports assignment but is not a new reaction.

regions.region: page 3 mechanism prose beginning Scheme 5 discussion
regions.finding: The working-model text continues through pages 4–5 and is classified as a proposed mechanism rather than observed preparative experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 3 analytical derivatization conditions are not given.
Scheme 4 omits scale, absolute solvent volumes, detailed workup/purification, and ee method.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed, not isolated.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Figure 1 and mechanism-text continuation
regions.finding: ORTEP of (R)-3 supports configuration assignment. It is structure evidence for Scheme 4, not an additional reaction; the accompanying text continues the proposed Scheme 5 model.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Table 3 reaction drawing, entries 1–16, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Sixteen substrate-scope experiments were retained row-by-row with 1.0 mmol substrate, standard catalyst/base/alcohol/MTBE/CO conditions, row times, isolated yields, and HPLC ee values. Entries 7, 13, and 14 retain 12, 10.5, and 12 h respectively.

regions.region: page 4 right-column General Information and start of the 2a typical procedure
regions.finding: Oven-/flame-dried apparatus, reagent handling, exact 2a quantities, CO replacement/200 psi charging, room-temperature 9 h reaction, and workup begin here and continue on page 5; these facts were merged with Table 3 entry 1 and the stated typical-procedure scope.

unresolved: Table 3 entries 11–16 have no row-specific experimental paragraph within pages 1–6.
Candidate structures and axial configurations remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 5 upper Scheme 5
regions.finding: Explicitly proposed Pd cycle with paths a/b and intermediates A–E; classified as a mechanism, not a set of observed experiments.

regions.region: page 5 left-column completion of the 2a typical procedure
regions.finding: Workup, flash chromatography, 210.4 mg, 81% isolated yield, 96% ee, and HPLC conditions complete the cross-page Table 3 entry-1 record. The paragraph states that 2b–2p and three alcohol variants were prepared according to this typical procedure.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left and right-column detailed preparations of 2b–2d
regions.finding: Exact catalyst, ligand, base, substrate, BnOH, MTBE, isolated-mass/yield, ee, chromatography, and HPLC facts were merged with Table 3 entries 2–4. No duplicate syntheses were created.

unresolved: The typical-procedure statement supports shared operation for 2k–2p, but their row-specific masses, chromatography eluents, and HPLC settings occur after page 6 and were not imported.
Spectral data do not establish machine structure verification.

regions.region: page 6 top-left completion of 2d characterization
regions.finding: The page completes characterization for the existing 2d preparation; no second reaction or outcome is reported.

regions.region: page 6 detailed preparations of 2e–2j
regions.finding: Six matching Table 3 records were enriched with exact catalyst/ligand/base/substrate/BnOH quantities, isolated masses/yields, ee values, chromatography eluents, and HPLC conditions. Each paragraph was merged with its table row rather than duplicated.

unresolved: The 2j characterization continues on page 7, outside the claimed page range; reaction facts complete on page 6 were retained.
No SI was supplied or associated; structures remain unverified despite parse checks.
